title: Reuse a prior confirmed conversation contract for a local draft

rubric.text: Uses the supplied prior confirmed contract without asking the same confirmation again

The generated plan targets the existing missing_file_error symbol and test method, prescribes the ordered implementation and exact test input/assertion, identifies expected red and green results, and gives the command working directory without implementing the change
The handoff is ready for a fresh executor, permits only bounded mechanical repair within the fixed contract, and stops for design changes or an exhausted repair budget
Creates only a marked local plan and leaves implementation and publication untouched
